scientific_integrity: Exact Cauchy–Binet algebra and sign analysis supply the global proof; standalone finite checks supplement it. A specialized earlier exact-design result could still cover it; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two known distinct positive decay rates, two unknown scalar amplitudes, three independent equal-variance observation events
Two events are compulsory at time zero and terminal time T; the third is free and may coincide with an endpoint
D-optimal Fisher determinant, not other design criteria or uncertain-rate estimation
Fixed-rate transition expansion and fixed-rate long-horizon asymptotic; no general multievent or high-dimensional claim
title: A sharp horizon transition for pinned observations of two exponential modes
